warning a11y_missing_attribute 8:1-8:6 `<img>` element should have an alt attribute
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_missing_attribute
warning a11y_consider_explicit_label 11:5-11:12 Buttons and links should either contain text or have an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title` attribute
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_consider_explicit_label
warning a11y_missing_attribute 11:5-11:12 `<a>` element should have an href attribute
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_missing_attribute
warning a11y_invalid_attribute 14:9-14:16 '' is not a valid href attribute
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_invalid_attribute
